title: Scratchpad Patching: Decoupling Compute from Patch Size in Byte-Level Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.09630v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tokenizer-free language models eliminate the tokenizer step of the language modeling pipeline by operating directly on bytes; patch-based variants further aggregate contiguous byte spans into patches for efficiency. However, the average patch size chosen at the model design stage governs a tight trade-off: larger patches reduce compute and KV-cache footprint, but degrade modeling quality. We trace this trade-off to patch lag: until a patch is fully observed, byte predictions within it must rely on a stale representation from the previous patch to preserve causality; this lag widens as patches grow larger. We introduce Scratchpad Patching (SP), which inserts transient scratchpads inside each patch to aggregate the bytes seen so far and refresh patch-level context for subsequent predictions. translated_title: 草稿纸补丁：在字节级语言模型中解耦计算量与补丁大小
translated_abstract: 无分词器语言模型通过直接在字节上进行操作，消除了语言建模流程中的分词器步骤；基于补丁的变体则进一步将连续的字节片段聚合为补丁以提升效率。然而，在模型设计阶段选定的平均补丁大小决定了一个紧密的权衡：更大的补丁可以减少计算量和KV缓存占用，但会降低建模质量。我们将这一权衡归因于补丁滞后：在补丁被完整观测到之前，其中的字节预测必须依赖来自上一个补丁的陈旧表示以保持因果性；随着补丁变大，这种滞后会不断加剧。我们提出了草稿纸补丁（Scratchpad Patching, SP），它在每个补丁内部插入临时草稿区，用以聚合目前已看到的字节，并为后续预测刷新补丁级上下文。SP利用下一字节预测熵来触发草稿区的生成，选择性地将计算分配给信息密集的区域，并支持事后调节（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“草稿纸补丁”（SP）方法，通过基于下一字节预测熵在补丁内部动态插入临时草稿区来刷新补丁级上下文，从而解决了字节级语言模型中补丁大小引起的计算效率与建模质量之间的权衡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Scratchpad Patching (SP), which dynamically inserts transient scratchpads within patches based on next-byte prediction entropy to refresh patch-level context, thereby decoupling compute from patch size and resolving the efficiency-quality trade-off in byte-level language models.
